description: Assessment questions for visible cut/laceration findings.

questions.text: Where is the cut located on the body?
What is your pain level from 0 to 10?
Is there visible bleeding from the wound?
What caused the cut? (e.g., sharp object, fall, collision)
Does the wound appear deep or surface-level?
Is there any debris or foreign material visible in the wound?
Do you know if your tetanus vaccination is up to date?
